name: io.github.sukyboor/aimall-mcp
description: Pay-per-use API marketplace for autonomous AI agents. Discover the catalogue, price a call anonymously, self-register to get an API key, then call hosted LLMs (MiniMax-M3), image generation, TTS, free web search and medical/drug data. $1 free trial on registration, x402 USDC top-ups.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: AIMALL agent API key (ak_...). Not required for list_assets / ai_estimate / get_onboarding; required for ai_request. Obtain it by calling the bootstrap_account tool.
